sloka: देवानां दानवानां च ऋषीणां भावितात्मनाम् ।हितमेव भविष्यद्धि रामप्रव्राजनादिह ॥ २.९२.३०॥
transliteration: devānāṁ dānavānāṁ ca ṛṣīṇāṁ bhāvitātmanām ।hitameva bhaviṣyaddhi rāmapravrājanādiha ॥ 2.92.30॥

translations.english: Banishment of Rama will bring about the welfare of the gods, the demons, and the sages of purified souls.
